descriptors.concept_name: Extracts of Financial Statements of Listed Entity for Share-Based Payments
descriptors.definition: Entity financial statements reflect equity-settled and cash-settled employee compensation plans through proportionate expense recognition and corresponding reserve or liability adjustments. Grant-date fair values determine overall expense computations while factoring estimated forfeitures and non-market performance metrics across the defined vesting period.
inclusion: Recognition of employee share-based payment expenses
Subsequent re-measurement of liabilities for cash-settled awards at fair value
Estimation of forfeitures and options expected to vest at reporting dates
exclusion: Awards failing to vest due to unmet service or non-market performance conditions
Unrelated employee benefit categories outside share-based compensation
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes equity-settled awards which credit a component of equity from cash-settled awards which establish a liability re-measured through profit or loss.
source_ambiguities: Source text cuts off mid-sentence at the end discussing market performance conditions.
